Agent Handoff

Product·by @jeetnirnejak·2026-08-27·inspora page·original post

What it is

Agent Handoff visualizer: a card showing 4 AI agents (Triage, Researcher, Writer, Reviewer) as icon nodes along a horizontal progress rail; a dot pulses along the rail as work hands off between agents, the active agent's icon lights up in its brand color while others grey out, and a 'HANDOFF LOG' beneath appends timestamped lines; Reset/Pause/Resume/Restart controls.

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-15%
Triage active (blue icon, colored dot at its node); log shows 'Run started: task assigned to Triage', 'parsing request intent'; bottom status 'Triage - classifying the request'.
15-35%
Handoff: dot slides along the rail from Triage to Researcher; Researcher icon ignites purple, Triage dims; log appends 'Triage -> Researcher: classified as research', 'querying Q2 ticket archive'; status line updates.
35-55%
Researcher -> Writer (orange icon); rail dot travels; log grows ('8 sources attached', 'drafting summary'); pause pressed mid-run: rail dot stops, controls swap Pause->Resume, 'Paused at 6.4s'.
55-80%
Resume; Writer -> Reviewer (green); rail fills with the gradient of completed segments (blue->purple->orange->green).
80-100%
Reviewer finishes ('running approval checks', 'verifying sign-off'); full rail colored end to end; Restart resets icons to grey, log clears.

Build prompt

Build an agent-handoff pipeline visualizer. Card 480px, white, radius 16, header 'Agent Handoff' + task title. Body: horizontal rail (2px track, grey) with 4 equally spaced agent nodes - each a 44px rounded-square icon (Triage blue, Researcher purple, Writer orange, Reviewer green). Inactive = greyscale icon at 40% opacity; active = full color with a springy scale pop (1->1.15->1, 300ms) and a soft colored glow behind. A 10px dot travels the rail marking progress; completed rail segments fill with a left-to-right gradient stitching the completed agents' colors. State machine: each agent holds for ~1.8s while 2-3 log lines append beneath ('HANDOFF LOG': monospace 11px, timestamped, each line fades in + rises 6px with 150ms stagger); on transition the dot eases to the next node in 500ms and the handoff line logs 'A -> B: reason'. Footer: live status text (currentAgent - currentAction) plus Reset / Pause / Resume (toggles) / Restart buttons; Pause freezes the dot mid-rail and shows 'Paused at X.Xs'; Restart greys all nodes, clears log, replays.

Mechanics

trigger
run simulation (auto-advancing state machine); pause/resume/reset
elements
4 agent icon nodes, progress rail with traveling dot + gradient fill, handoff log (appending lines), control buttons
properties
dot x-position along rail, segment fill color/width, icon color saturation (grey->brand), log line entrance (fade+rise), status text swap
timing
each agent phase ~1.5-2s; dot travel between nodes ~500ms; log lines stagger 150ms
easing
ease-in-out dot travel; spring on icon activation (scale 1->1.15->1)
loop
restartable run, not infinite
